channel.title: Kiki Updates
channel.description: Developer ID signed and notarized updates for Kiki.

item.description:
# Kiki 0.6.36
- Rebuilds the Templeton Technologies footer on About as responsive app content. - Inherits Kiki’s About canvas color instead of using the darker sidebar color. - Preserves the supplied footer proportions while scaling the lockup with the window. - Keeps the complete footer reachable at Kiki’s compact supported window size.

# Kiki 0.6.35
- Rebuilt Home as a responsive workflow launchpad with consistent capability cards and contextual setup checks. - Clarified Voice Studio as a four-step record, install, create, and export workflow. - Added the Templeton Technologies product footer to About using the approved 698 × 318 layout. - Added a Check for Updates action to About and separate automatic checking and automatic download/install preferences in Settings. - Improved narrow-window behavior and added diagnostics for update controls, About actions, Home geometry, and Voice Studio workflow structure.

# Kiki 0.6.34
- Smoothed long Voice Studio output across generated sections so volume and transitions remain consistent. - Added gentle edge cleanup, crossfades, and loudness matching without sending audio off the Mac. - Added checksum verification for Whisper and Kiki's local voice models. - Kiki now removes and repairs a corrupted model automatically instead of trying to load it or silently accepting it. - Clarified whether Voice Studio is verifying, downloading, repairing, or generating.

# Kiki 0.6.33
- Reworked Kiki's interface around a consistent compact spacing, typography, surface, and control system. - Fixed Learning table rows and selection highlights so text stays vertically centered at every window size. - Made correction scope default to the app where Kiki observed an app-specific edit. - Tightened Voice Studio, navigation, buttons, tables, history, dictionary, and speaker editing for a calmer native Mac layout.

# Kiki 0.6.32
- Lets you correct a pending learning suggestion before approving it. - Adds a clear Remove Suggestion action beside the selected suggestion. - Keeps the review controls compact and aligned at every supported window size.
